note: The ground surface for the map's Terrain layer only. It is the raw, unfilled surface; the scenario engine routes on a separate conditioned one. Heights are estimated from filtered aerial photography, about 25 cm vertically, and interpolated under roofs and canopy.

source.publisher: City of Melbourne Open Data Portal

ground.note: Divide by the scale for metres AHD. The raw surface: not filled, buildings not raised.

buildings.note: One bit per cell, most significant first, 1 inside a building footprint.

shade.note: Hillshade, 0 to 255 for 0 to 1, already attenuated towards 0.5 where the ground was not measured. Multiply, never lighten.
